scope: Targeted update from publisher papers and official repositories; not an exhaustive systematic review

references.name: GCNet Golden Cudgel Network
references.read_scope: CVF abstract; official README, training configuration and speed script. Full CVF PDF access failed.
references.method: Training-time vertical and horizontal convolution paths are reparameterized for inference.
references.comparability: Official config uses 19 classes, ImageNet-style normalization, augmentation, OHEM and 120k iterations. Speed script times synthetic-input model inference plus resize with CUDA synchronization; not real-image end-to-end latency.
references.decision: Use as deployment and related-work reference. Do not transplant reparameterization into input-dependent nonlinear CA, replace the controlled backbone, or import author FPS as local RTX4060 performance.
references.recency_note: 2026-04-16 repository update adds a license; does not make the CVPR2025 method a 2026 model.

references.name: TBMSNet
references.read_scope: Publisher article including architecture, implementation and code-availability statement
references.method: Detail, semantic and boundary branches with a stem, dilated convolution and multi-scale pooling.
references.comparability: Paper reports ImageNet pretraining, 484 Cityscapes epochs, batch12,1024x1024 crops and augmentation; main model22.9M parameters. Final inference training includes train+val; such weights cannot provide independent validation-set comparison here.
references.code_availability: Upon request to corresponding author; no freely downloadable official implementation verified.
references.decision: Borrow the motivation for boundary and detail analysis. Do not add its full multi-branch model or training as a required <=50CNY undergraduate experiment.

references.name: PILOT
references.read_scope: Official repository README; publisher full-text access returned429, not independently checked
references.method: Incremental segmentation with a frozen PIDNet backbone and a parallel lightweight branch; uses new-class data without retaining previous training data.
references.decision: Different problem from fixed binary sidewalk segmentation; keep as future work, no continual-learning experiments or performance claims based on unread full text.

updated_decisions: Preserve all ABC results and the predeclared D/E comparison. Novelty is a controlled task-specific investigation plus engineering validation, not invention of scalar residual gating.
Current evidence supports useful learned attention structure. Do not frame the thesis as having established universal attention failure or selective sidewalk suppression.
Complete bounded D/E experiments, then deployment accuracy equivalence and local latency/P95/memory measurements. No new paid server or hardware.
At most one optional modern pretrained inference reference after core work; pin source, count actual parameters, check training split, and present separately from controlled ablations.
Real local road images and human annotation review remain necessary for field validation. Semantic sidewalk labels alone do not establish safe traversability.
